public_rationale: Marcus said GPT-5 did no better on the parts-and-wholes image problems he and Ernest Davis had discussed in December. The packet contains no independent test of these prompts on GPT-5-era ChatGPT in August 2025. The closest evidence is Davis's own rerun, dated 8 July 2025, a month before GPT-5's launch (e1). It found ChatGPT-4o's image generation much improved since November 2024 on these prompts (e1). Failures in three tries fell from 11 to 4 of those examples, plus one failure on a new prompt (e2). That test predates GPT-5, and the packet does not confirm which image model GPT-5-era ChatGPT used. So the evidence neither supports nor contradicts the claim for August 2025.
limitations: The only systematic test predates GPT-5 and used ChatGPT-4o.
Which image model GPT-5 ChatGPT used at launch is unconfirmed.
The reading of 'fared no better' (no improvement versus still failing) changes the result.
